description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of the length of the gold prefix for two different conditions: consistency (wait-1) and inconsistency (wait-9). The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," ranges from 0 to 20 in increments of 5, representing the number of tokens in the prefix. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 23 to 29, with gridlines at intervals of 1, indicating the quality of machine translation output. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents the consistency condition (wait-1), which starts at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5, dips to a low of about 23.8 at a prefix length of 1, and then generally increases to a final value of approximately 28.0 at a prefix length of 20. The red solid line with square markers represents the inconsistency condition (wait-9), which begins at a BLEU score of about 25.0, fluctuates between approximately 25.0 and 26.0 for most of the prefix lengths, and ends at a BLEU score of about 25.8 at a prefix length of 20. The legend in the top-left corner identifies the two lines by their respective conditions.
